result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there is one clear visual defect: the circular button in the top-right header is empty, showing only a red notification dot with no icon inside. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom are expected scrolling behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner of the header, next to the delivery address, is a blank light-gray circle with only a small red badge dot. The icon or avatar that should sit inside it (probably a notification bell or profile image) is missing or failed to load, so the button's purpose is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Check that the icon or avatar asset loads and renders inside the button. Add a fallback glyph (e.g. bell icon or user initials) for when the image fails, and give the button an accessible label.
